about.title: About
about.description: A web application to analyze, safely edit, and move Terraform state across existing backends — with CI-driven drift detection and version testing.

help.title: Help
help.none: No help is available for this page yet.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.body: A cross-source overview: total Resources Under Management (RUM), provider and resource breakdowns, Terraform version spread, and recent drift and version-lab activity.

sources.title: Sources
sources.body: Connect to existing state backends (local, HCP/TFC, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Git). Browse each source's state files, view analysis, inspect resources, and safely edit state with lock → backup → write → audit.

drift.title: Drift
drift.body: Dispatch a Terraform plan through your CI (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) to compare state against code and live infrastructure. Results return via a signed one-shot callback and render as a per-resource diff.

versionLab.title: Version Lab
versionLab.body: Test whether your Terraform code plans cleanly against a chosen Terraform version (and optional pinned provider versions / registry mirror) by dispatching init/plan to your CI.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Generate an analyzer report for a state file — RUM, resource/provider/version breakdowns — and download it as Markdown, JSON, or CSV.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.body: Copy (backup) or move (migrate) a state file between sources. Migrate verifies serial/lineage/resource-count parity on the target and can optionally decommission the original after a type-to-confirm guard.
